evals.name: safe_404_removal_is_logged_and_revertible
evals._note: Tool behaviour, not model behaviour (was filed as `prompt`). NOT YET EXECUTABLE: tools/seed_curator.py reads only the live feed registry and --apply/--revert write ledger/feeds-change-log.json, so an honest fixture needs a registry-path parameter and an isolated log first.
